The *Sañjayattheragāthā* (Thag 1.48) is a canonical Pali verse attributed to the elder (thera) Sañjaya, preserved within the *Theragāthā* collection of the Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. The text constitutes a single verse entry in the collection's first nipāta [SuttaCentral]. 

Modern scholarship and translations recorded on SuttaCentral include nine translations across eight languages, among them an English version by Bhikkhu Sujato [SuttaCentral].
